integrity: The method and adaptive shape condition are credited to the cited original paper; all proof statements and checker code are original mathematical analysis of a smooth flat-zero witness. The source bounded-shape theorem is not contradicted.
limitations: Uncapped exact shape rule; one exact-data step on uniform grids; no claim of recursive global divergence or robustness under clipping; 2020 related full text not inspected.
title: Smooth flat-zero data force an exploding exact-start defect in two-stage Gaussian RBF Runge–Kutta integration
